jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

About GoldCare

GoldCare, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized healthcare management software for community-based healthcare and long-term care organizations. Part of Constellation Software since 2014, GoldCare has built long-standing relationships with healthcare providers who rely on its technology to simplify their operations, improve efficiency, and focus less on paperwork and more on people.

Who we need

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director of Technology to shape the next phase of GoldCare’s technology and product evolution. In this newly created role, you will define and execute our technology strategy, lead the modernization of our healthcare software platform, and establish the architecture, engineering practices, and technical capabilities that will support our future growth. Combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement, you will lead our distributed Development and Quality Assurance teams, balancing the needs of our existing products and customers with the development of more modern technology solutions. You will work closely with Product Management to align technology strategy with product priorities and customer needs, playing a central role in how we build software, introduce new technologies, and evolve as a software business.

This is a fully remote role based anywhere in Canada, with working hours aligned to Eastern Time.

What’s in it for you

Modernize technology that makes a difference. You will join an established healthcare software business at a pivotal point in its evolution. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of our platform, modernizing business-critical software and exploring how emerging technologies can enhance its capabilities. What makes this opportunity particularly meaningful is the impact of your work beyond the technology itself. The decisions you make and the solutions you build will help community-based healthcare and long-term care organizations operate more effectively, reduce administrative burdens, and dedicate more time to the people in their care.

The freedom to lead, build, and influence. You want to remain close to technology without sacrificing the breadth and influence of a senior leadership role. Working directly with the General Manager, you will have the autonomy to challenge existing thinking, make architectural decisions, influence technology investments, and turn your ideas into reality. You will build on the knowledge and experience of an established team while introducing modern engineering practices, encouraging experimentation with AI and emerging technologies, and developing technical leaders. This is an opportunity to leave a lasting impact not only on what we build but on how we think, collaborate, and innovate as a technology organization.

Broader exposure and career growth. You will benefit from the autonomy of an entrepreneurial software business, backed by the stability, collective knowledge, and resources of Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network. You will have opportunities to exchange ideas with technology leaders navigating similar transformations, gain exposure to different software businesses, and learn from diverse approaches to innovation. As you shape GoldCare’s technology future, you will deepen your commercial understanding, expand your leadership capabilities, and position yourself for broader technology leadership opportunities over time.

As our new Director, Technology, you will

Own the technology roadmap.
You will establish a clear technology vision and translate it into a multi-year roadmap with defined priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking ownership of moving initiatives from concept through implementation and delivery.
Partner with Product Management.
You will work collaboratively with the Product Management team to shape the product roadmap, align technology investments with product priorities, and translate customer needs into scalable, practical software solutions. Together, you will evaluate opportunities, navigate technical and commercial trade-offs, and balance platform modernization with the delivery of new features and enhancements that create meaningful value for our customers.
Lead platform modernization.
You will assess our existing architecture, challenge technical assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to determine the best direction for our software. You will own architectural and technology stack decisions, guiding the evolution of our application architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud services. Working alongside our technical teams, you will actively participate in designing, developing, and validating solutions that strengthen the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of our platform.
Transform how we build software.
You will work alongside our distributed teams to develop, test, and deliver software. You will establish DevOps capabilities and take a hands-on approach to introducing and advancing CI/CD, automated testing, and Agile development practices. You will help the team move beyond reactive problem-solving, address the root causes of recurring challenges, and drive measurable improvements in software quality, productivity, and delivery.
Turn innovation into impact.
You will proactively explore how AI, automation, and emerging technologies can enhance our products and improve how we work. You will assess technical feasibility and business value, experiment with new technologies, build prototypes, and work alongside the team to translate promising ideas into practical solutions that benefit our business and customers.
Strengthen security and reliability.
You will guide decisions across cloud infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
Build and empower technical teams.
You will lead our distributed Development and Quality Assurance teams, develop technical leaders, strengthen accountability, and address capability gaps. You will lead by example, sharing your technical expertise, demonstrating new approaches, and working alongside the team to solve complex problems. You will create an environment where people are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment, make informed decisions, and take ownership of solutions.
Connect technology to business priorities.
You will act as a trusted technology partner to the General Manager, proactively bringing forward ideas, recommendations, and opportunities to advance the business. You will articulate the commercial implications of technology decisions, communicate risks and trade-offs, and influence where we invest. You will also collaborate with technology leaders across the broader organization to exchange expertise, share learnings, and explore new approaches.

You bring

The technology leadership experience.
You have progressed through software engineering or architecture into senior technology leadership within an enterprise software business. You have led technical teams and managers, with accountability for technology strategy, investment decisions, engineering performance, and business outcomes. You know how to establish a technology vision, build support for it, and take an active role in bringing it to life.
The platform modernization expertise.
You have led the modernization of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and existing customer commitments. You are comfortable challenging established architectural approaches, exploring alternatives, and making technology stack decisions with long-term implications. Your experience extends beyond defining the strategy to actively contributing to the design and implementation of technical solutions.
The hands-on technical depth.
You bring broad expertise across enterprise architecture, application development, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud environments, complemented by an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. Your expertise is not confined to a single technology stack, and you have intentionally remained close to the technology as your leadership responsibilities have grown. You are comfortable moving between strategic discussions, architectural design, coding, prototyping, and working alongside developers to solve complex technical problems.
The curiosity and drive to innovate.
You are genuinely curious about technology and how it can be applied to solve business and customer challenges. You have hands-on experience introducing modern engineering practices, establishing DevOps capabilities, and advancing CI/CD and automated testing to improve how software is built and delivered. You actively explore new approaches, experiment with emerging technologies, including AI and automation, and know how to translate promising ideas into practical solutions.
The business acumen.
You understand the commercial implications of technology decisions and can balance customer needs, financial priorities, operational demands, and long-term growth. You can evaluate investments, articulate complex technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences, and build alignment with senior leaders. You look beyond immediate challenges to understand their root causes, proactively bringing forward recommendations and taking ownership of seeing them through.
The ability to lead through change.
You have developed technical leaders, strengthened accountability, and built collaboration across distributed teams. You earn credibility through your technical expertise and willingness to work alongside others, demonstrating new approaches rather than simply directing change. You know how to bring people with you, respectfully challenge established thinking, and create an environment where people are encouraged to experiment, learn, and take ownership of solutions.

Why join?

GoldCare and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.
If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At GoldCare and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we're the team behind Money Mart—Canada's largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

We've Got You Covered

Compensation Philosophy:
Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

Discretionary Annual Bonus:
Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

Comprehensive Benefits:
Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

Retirement Plans:
Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you're set for the long haul.

Hybrid Work Environment:
Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

Perks and Rewards:
Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

What You'll Do

The Job:
Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

As the Director, Data Architecture & Information Management
, you will serve as the organization's designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

What You'll Do

Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.
Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.
Define and lead the organization's Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.
Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.
Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.
Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.
Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.
Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.
Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.
Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.
Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.
Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.
Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a related discipline.
Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.
Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.
Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.
Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

Committed to Equal Opportunity:

MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.

About MFSG – Our Commitment To Responsible Innovation

At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada's Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable. We may use AI to screen, assess or select applicants.

This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities.

We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) / Director - Digital Platforms & Delivery Excellence
jobs.description:
À propos de Genetec :

Genetec est à la pointe des technologies de sécurité et d'exploitation, et stimule l'innovation pour renforcer la sécurité et l'efficacité à l'échelle mondiale. Au sein de notre Digital Information Office (DIO), nous développons et exploitons des solutions numériques qui soutiennent les fonctions métier essentielles dans les domaines de la finance, du juridique, des opérations, des ventes, du marketing et auprès d'autres parties prenantes internes.

Alors que notre écosystème numérique ne cesse de se développer, nous recherchons un directeur des plateformes numériques et de l'excellence opérationnelle chargé de mettre en place et de faire évoluer les plateformes, les pratiques et les normes de qualité qui permettent à nos équipes de développement de fournir des solutions fiables, évolutives et sécurisées pour l'ensemble du portefeuille du DIO.

Aperçu du poste :

Nous recherchons un(e) directeur(trice) des plateformes numériques internes et de l'excellence opérationnelle pour diriger les plateformes internes partagées, les pratiques de qualité et les capacités de livraison qui soutiennent le développement logiciel au sein du Digital Information Office (DIO).

Ce poste consiste à définir et à mettre en œuvre les normes, les cadres de qualité, les plateformes de livraison et les pratiques de développement utilisés par les équipes applicatives du DIO. Les domaines de responsabilité comprennent l'assurance qualité, les pipelines CI/CD, les plateformes de développement internes, les normes de livraison logicielle et la gouvernance des API.

Ce poste est idéal pour un(e) leader pragmatique et axé sur l'exécution, capable d'améliorer la qualité, la cohérence et les performances de livraison tout en établissant des partenariats solides entre les équipes du DIO. Pour réussir dans cette fonction, il est nécessaire d'avoir occupé certains ou plusieurs des postes énumérés. Ce poste s'adresse à ceux qui sont prêts à retrousser leurs manches et à construire quelque chose d'évolutif.

Responsabilités principales :

Stratégie et feuille de route

Élaborer, définir et susciter l'adhésion à la stratégie d'ingénierie, hiérarchiser les priorités et aligner tous les objectifs sur les objectifs généraux de l'organisation
Élaborer une feuille de route claire sur 18 à 24 mois tenant compte des contraintes et des dépendances, et permettant de réaffecter les ressources et de s'adapter aux événements métier tout au long du processus
Promouvoir l'amélioration continue et l'excellence opérationnelle au sein des équipes technologiques de l'organisation

Organisation

Concevoir et faire évoluer les structures des équipes, allouer les ressources et mettre en place des processus qui favorisent la réussite à long terme des collaborateurs et du département
Recruter, organiser et développer les talents, notamment en investissant de manière réfléchie dans les parcours professionnels et la relève

Normes de développement et qualité

Assurer la maîtrise des normes de développement logiciel et des pratiques de qualité au sein du Digital Information Office (DIO)
Définir, publier et améliorer en permanence les normes de développement, les pratiques de codage et les contrôles de qualité utilisés par les équipes applicatives du DIO
Diriger la fonction d'assurance qualité, notamment la stratégie de test, les pratiques d'automatisation, les critères de préparation à la mise en production et la gouvernance de la qualité en tant que capacité partagée
Assurer la visibilité sur les tendances en matière de qualité et l'état de santé des livraisons, permettant ainsi une prise de décision éclairée au sein de l'équipe de direction du DIO
Définir et maintenir les pratiques de gouvernance des déploiements, notamment les revues de préparation, les contrôles de qualité et les contrôles de mise en production

Plateformes de développement et DevOps

Définir les orientations de la stratégie et des outils de la plateforme CI/CD, en veillant à ce que les équipes de développement disposent de processus fiables et efficaces pour la création, les tests et le déploiement des applications
Assurer la gestion et l'évolution de l'infrastructure de développement, des environnements, des outils et des plateformes de développement de DIO, en mettant l'accent sur la fiabilité, l'évolutivité, l'optimisation des coûts et la productivité des développeurs
Réduire les frictions liées à la mise en production en standardisant et en simplifiant les workflows de développement et les capacités de la plateforme
Encourager l'adoption de pratiques modernes de livraison logicielle et d'automatisation au sein des équipes DIO

Interfaces numériques et gouvernance des API

Définir et promouvoir une approche « API-first » pour les solutions et intégrations DIO
Établir des normes en matière de conception, de documentation, de gestion du cycle de vie, de sécurité et de gestion des versions des API
Veiller à ce que les pratiques de gouvernance des API soient intégrées dans les workflows de développement, les contrôles qualité et les pipelines de livraison
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes chargées de la plateforme API et de l'intégration afin d'harmoniser les normes, les outils et les approches de mise en œuvre
Favoriser les modèles de services et d'intégration réutilisables qui améliorent l'interopérabilité entre les systèmes métier

Direction d'équipe et développement des compétences

Diriger, encadrer et faire évoluer une équipe composée de responsables et de collaborateurs dans les domaines de l'assurance qualité, de l'ingénierie des plateformes, du DevOps et de l'accompagnement au développement
Évaluer les capacités de l'organisation et développer de manière proactive les compétences en matière de qualité logicielle, d'automatisation, de plateformes cloud et de pratiques de livraison
Favoriser une culture collaborative et axée sur le service, fondée sur le partenariat, l'accompagnement et l'amélioration continue
Renforcer sa crédibilité et son influence grâce à son expertise, à la collaboration et à des résultats mesurables

Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline technique connexe
Un master ou un MBA est considéré comme un atout
Plus de 12 ans d'expérience dans le développement logiciel et à des postes de direction technique
Expérience avérée dans la mise en place de normes de livraison logicielle, de pratiques d'assurance qualité et de capacités CI/CD dans des environnements complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes
Solide expérience des indicateurs de livraison (DORA ou équivalent) et de l'utilisation d'analyses basées sur les données pour améliorer la qualité et les résultats de livraison
Expérience dans la direction de fonctions liées aux plateformes, au DevOps, à l'assurance qualité ou à l'habilitation technologique, en soutien à plusieurs équipes de livraison
Solide expérience en automatisation des builds et des mises en production, en stratégies de test, en plateformes cloud et en outils de développement
Capacité avérée à influencer les résultats au sein des équipes et auprès des parties prenantes sans lien hiérarchique direct
Expérience au sein d'entreprises spécialisées dans les logiciels d'entreprise, le SaaS ou les technologies B2B
Grande crédibilité technique et capacité à communiquer efficacement tant avec un public technique qu'avec un public métier
Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite d'interagir avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)

Qualités de leader :

Leader axé(e) sur l'exécution, soucieux(euse) de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la qualité et des résultats mesurables
Collaboratif(ve) et accessible, capable de faire respecter les normes tout en entretenant des partenariats solides
Excellent(e) communicateur(trice), capable de simplifier les questions complexes et de susciter l'adhésion de divers groupes de parties prenantes
Leader soucieux(euse) du service, sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre gouvernance et accompagnement
Engagé(e) en faveur de l'amélioration continue et de la promotion d'une culture de haute performance

Qualités souhaitées:

Expérience dans la modernisation d'applications héritées vers des architectures orientées services ou natives du cloud
Expérience dans la direction d'équipes techniques distribuées ou dispersées à l'échelle mondiale
Bonne connaissance des plateformes d'entreprise, des systèmes métier internes et des initiatives de transformation numérique
Expérience dans la mise en place de capacités de prise en charge des plateformes et de la mise en œuvre au sein d'une organisation technologique interne

Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

jobs.title: Senior Director, Delivery and Service Enablement
jobs.description:
Come make your difference in communities across Canada, where authenticity, trust and making connections is valued – as we shape the future of Canadian retail, together. Our unique position as one of the country's largest employers, coupled with our commitment to positively impact the lives of all Canadians, provides our colleagues a range of opportunities and experiences to help Canadians Live Life Well®.

At Loblaw Companies Limited, we succeed through collaboration and commitment and set a high bar for ourselves and those around us. Whether you are just starting your career, re-entering the workforce, or looking for a new job, this is where you belong.

Loblaw Technology and Analytics power some of Canada’s most game-changing retail solutions. We connect Canadians to things that matter most. Food, health, beauty, money, and time. Curiosity drives us as we solve complex problems at pace and lay foundation for a secure organization today while influencing a better future for our customers tomorrow. Join us and work alongside some of Canada’s most diverse and talented innovators supporting retail, digital customer solutions and analytical platforms.

The Impact You'll Make

The Senior Director will lead the teams accountable for Operational Reporting, Project Governance, Hardware and Software Asset Management, and the enterprise-wide Cost to Serve (CTS) initiative. Building on an established operating foundation, this leader will raise the bar on performance, challenge existing ways of working, and drive measurable improvements across Loblaw Technology & Analytics (LTA) and its business partners. The role will influence decisions and drive accountability beyond its direct teams, using data, automation, and actionable insights to strengthen operating discipline, optimize costs, and drive sustainable benefits across enterprise cost plans. The Senior Director will also provide executive operations and strategic planning leadership for the Chief Technology & Analytics Officer (CTAO) and leadership team, shaping the annual planning process and ensuring executive priorities translate into outcomes. This role reports directly to the VP, Infrastructure Operations.

What You'll Do

Lead Governance Operations and Technology teams to elevate an already strong operating foundation; challenge the status quo, embed continuous improvement, and drive measurable changes in efficiency, effectiveness, service quality, and accountability across LTA.
Set the direction for governance and performance management across technology projects, products, platforms, and services; use meaningful KPIs, trusted data, and automation to surface risks and opportunities, influence leadership decisions, and ensure cross-functional owners act on insights and deliver results.
Support the enterprise-wide Cost to Serve (CTS) strategy and governance approach across business functions, operations, products, channels, and services—not limited to technology. Partner with Finance and business leaders; identify structural cost and demand drivers, benchmark performance, assess investment and service trade-offs, and prioritize high-value opportunities. Mobilize cross-functional action plans, establish owners and targets, track realized financial and operational benefits, and embed ongoing cost optimization without compromising customer or business outcomes.
Advance hardware and software asset management across the full lifecycle, strengthening inventory and entitlement accuracy, licensing compliance, utilization, renewals, and risk controls; use analytics and automation to reduce waste, optimize spend, and demonstrate sustained value.
Lead CTAO Executive Operations and Strategic Planning, shaping the leadership cadence, decision-ready materials, and annual planning process; connect strategic priorities to accountable owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes, and challenge barriers to execution across functions.
Act as a trusted partner and constructive challenger to senior leaders across LTA and the business; influence decisions beyond direct reporting lines, resolve cross-functional issues, accelerate change adoption, and translate insights into sustained improvements in performance, cost, resilience, and value delivery.

What You Bring

Proven senior leadership experience developing teams, influencing senior stakeholders beyond direct authority, challenging established practices constructively, and driving cross-functional accountability and measurable outcomes through compelling executive communication.
Strong expertise in governance, operational performance, and transformation, including defining decision-useful KPIs, applying data and automation, diagnosing root causes, leading change, and converting insights into sustained operational improvement.
Strategic experience leading enterprise-wide Cost to Serve and cost optimization beyond technology, including cost-driver and unit-cost methodologies, financial and operational modelling, investment trade-offs, value opportunity prioritization, and rigorous tracking of benefits realization in partnership with Finance and business leaders.

Vice President, Controller

How does the role impact the organization?

The Vice President, Controller is a senior finance leader responsible for the integrity of the organization’s financial records, consolidated financial statements, regulatory reporting, accounting policies, controls, and core accounting operations. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the role provides trusted advice to executive leadership, ensures compliance with applicable accounting tax and regulatory requirements, and builds scalable processes that support accurate, timely, and decision-useful financial information. Controllership and Executive Leadership

Advise the Chief Financial Officer and executive leadership on accounting conclusions, reporting risks, control matters, and regulatory developments.
Establish the operating model, service standards, and priorities in alignment with enterprise objectives.
Provide clear, balanced recommendations on complex transactions, organizational initiatives, and matters affecting financial integrity.

At Range Group
we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. All our investments stem from a common thesis, that travel advisors add real value to a trip. Travel advisors when equipped with technology and 24/7 support are irreplaceable. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

About The Role

This is a hands-on senior finance leadership role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You’re as comfortable building a complex multi-entity model from scratch as you are presenting the story behind the numbers to the executive team.

As Director, FP&A, you will own the analytical engine that supports decision-making across Range Group’s portfolio of travel brands — leading enterprise planning and forecasting, managing a small team, and working directly with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, navigate risks, and drive performance.

What You’ll Do

Financial Modelling & Planning

Build, maintain, and continuously improve financial models covering consolidated Group performance, brand-level P&Ls, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Own the Group-level cash flow tracker and EBITDA bridging model, ensuring accuracy and timeliness week over week.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.
Support ad hoc financial analysis — acquisition modelling, business case development, and covenant compliance.
Drive continuous improvement in financial planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and analytical tools.

Performance Management & Executive Insights

Own enterprise-wide performance reporting — financial reviews, KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, and variance commentary.
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.
Translate financial results into clear, decision-ready insights that prompt action.
Identify and proactively flag emerging risks, opportunities, and performance trends across the portfolio.

Strategic Business Partnership

Partner with executive and business leaders to align financial plans with strategic priorities and growth objectives.
Evaluate investments, business initiatives, and strategic opportunities through modelling and scenario analysis.
Provide financial leadership on strategic initiatives, business cases, and investment decisions.
Support executive and Board reporting requirements.

Treasury & Foreign Exchange Management

Own foreign exchange exposure tracking, reporting, and scenario analysis across the Group's multi-currency operations.
Partner with treasury, banking partners, and external advisors to evaluate foreign exchange risks and mitigation strategies.
Assess the financial impact of currency fluctuations on forecasts, budgets, cash flow, and business performance.
Develop recommendations and decision-support materials for leadership regarding FX risk management and capital planning.
Monitor market trends and currency movements, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead a small finance team — including a Finance Manager and intern — as a player-coach: owning models and analysis end-to-end while delegating and developing where appropriate.
Foster a high-performance, analytically rigorous culture within the team.
Support ERP and reporting tool improvements from a finance data and output perspective.
Champion the evolution of finance from a reporting function to a true strategic business partner.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or Finance Business Partnering — with a track record of owning complex models in a multi-entity environment.
Advanced Excel skills — non-negotiable. You build models from scratch, structure them for auditability, and are fast and precise in the tool.
Strong accounting foundation: you understand how the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect inside a model.
Proven experience leading enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
Experience analyzing foreign exchange exposure, multi-currency financial impacts, and scenario modelling within a corporate FP&A, finance, or strategic finance environment.
Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and capable of influencing and constructively challenging stakeholders.
Experience in multi-entity and multi-currency operating environments.
CPA designation strongly preferred; candidates without the designation will be considered where technical skills and experience are strong.
Background in travel, technology, hospitality, or another fast-paced, multi-brand environment is an asset.

Who You Are

You are a builder. You prefer to own models end-to-end and take pride in work that is structured, auditable, and built to last.
You are intellectually curious and detail-oriented, but able to zoom out and connect the numbers to a broader business narrative.
You operate well with ambiguity and can manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or composure.
You are a collaborative leader who still wants to be close to the work — energized by doing, not just directing.
You communicate with a low-ego, peer-level style — credible with senior stakeholders, collegial with the broader team, and proactive about surfacing issues.

Why Join Range Group

This is a rare opportunity to bridge corporate finance and executive strategy in a multi-brand travel and technology portfolio. You’ll have genuine influence — shaping how capital is allocated, how performance is communicated, and how the finance function evolves as the company grows.

The role carries real complexity: multi-entity consolidations, multi-currency exposure, and a direct reporting line to the Chief Finance Officer. You’ll lead a small team and have the space to build the frameworks and processes that become the foundation for the company’s next phase.

Hybrid Work Model

We’re based in Toronto and targeting three days in office per week, with flexibility built in.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. You are expected to operate as a force multiplier — directing AI agents across multiple workstreams, validating output for production safety, and coaching others to do the same. Headquartered in Montreal, Detroit and Munich, Vention helps manufacturers automate their operations in record time with the only hardware and software AI-powered platform built for the factory floor. At Vention, you’ll work alongside driven and talented people who care deeply about their craft and the impact they create. We’re a team of high achievers who grow through meaningful work, solving complex challenges, learning fast, and seeing the results of our efforts every day.

We move quickly and aim high, but we do it together with care, collaboration, and respect. Our culture celebrates diverse perspectives and supports your growth through intentional development, strong leadership, and opportunities to make a real difference.

What You’ll Do

Sitting at the nexus of robotics and Physical AI, Vention is transforming how businesses automate their factory floors. Scaling rapidly at Series D, Vention is on a fast track from hypergrowth scale-up to an IPO-ready enterprise. We are seeking a highly strategic but hands-on VP of Accounting to guide this transition and build a public company ready accounting function.

Public Readiness: Own and drive the roadmap to ensure Vention operates with public-company readiness within the next 24-36 months, supporting a potential IPO in the next 3 to 5 years. This will include an IFRS conversion and building a stronger internal controls framework
Team Development: Leading a team of 9 high performing professionals, you will cultivate a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development across the team
Controllership & Financial Close: Drive the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close cycles and lead the interim and annual cycles
Financial Reporting: Oversee the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements in compliance with ASPE (and eventually IFRS) and present results to the Audit Committee quarterly
Technical Accounting: Guide the preparation of technical accounting memos to support new business initiatives or transactions. Revenue recognition will be a particular focus, including addressing complex, multi-element revenue arrangements
Tax Compliance: Partner with external advisors to remain compliant and to optimize sales taxes, corporate taxes, SR&ED, and transfer pricing across multiple jurisdictions and legal entities
Operational Finance: Optimize working capital through AR and AP management, streamline vendor disbursement cycles, enforce T&E policies, and ensure seamless payroll execution
Financial Systems: Scale the financial tech stack (NetSuite) to ensure our systems and internal controls can fully support a publicly listed company
Special Projects: Partner on special projects to help grow and scale the business (e.g. financing rounds, tariff mitigation, opening new offices)

What You Bring To The Table

12+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role

Leadership style: Must have a “builder” mentality and a strong player-coach working style to model the way, equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves on complex technical issues as presenting updates to the Audit Committee. Chez Vention, vous travaillerez aux côtés de personnes passionnées et talentueuses qui ont à cœur leur métier et l’impact qu’elles créent. Nous formons une équipe de personnes ambitieuses qui évoluent grâce à un travail porteur de sens, en relevant des défis complexes, en apprenant rapidement et en constatant chaque jour les résultats de leurs efforts.

Ce Que Vous Ferez

Située au carrefour de la robotique et de l’intelligence artificielle physique, Vention transforme la façon dont les entreprises automatisent leurs usines. En pleine phase d’expansion rapide (série D), Vention évolue rapidement, passant du stade d’entreprise en hypercroissance à celui d’une société prête pour une entrée en bourse (IPO). Systèmes financiers : Faire évoluer l’infrastructure technologique financière (NetSuite) afin de garantir que nos systèmes et nos contrôles internes soient en mesure de soutenir une société cotée en bourse.
Projets spéciaux : Collaborer à des projets spéciaux visant à soutenir la croissance et le développement de l’entreprise (p. ex. rondes de financement, atténuation des droits tarifaires, ouverture de nouveaux bureaux).

Ce que vous apportez à l’équipe

Plus de 12 ans d'expérience progressive en comptabilité, dont au moins 4 ans à un poste de direction.
Une expérience préalable en matière de conduite de transformations en vue d'un PAPE ou en tant que contrôleur/vice-président comptable au sein d'une société cotée en bourse est requise. Une expérience au sein d'entreprises à forte croissance financées par du capital de risque ou du capital-investissement est un atout.
Expert-comptable agréé (CPA) en exercice, avec de l'expérience au sein d'un cabinet du Big Four et une expertise en normes IFRS.
Forte présence et capacité avérée à remettre en question les décideurs de manière constructive et à simplifier des concepts complexes en recommandations concrètes.
Style de leadership : Vous devez avoir une mentalité de bâtisseur et un style de travail de mentorat affirmé, capable de montrer l'exemple.
